instagram.body:
This is the app I open before any other app now 👾

#raycast #productivity #buildinpublic #founderlife #aiworkflow 

{ Raycast, Mac productivity, AI workflow, founder tools, productivity hacks, app declutter, Mac setup, automation tools, launcher app, workflow automation, tech stack, solopreneur tools, AI for founders }
I spent ₹20,000 on this app, and honestly, I love it. It has replaced five different apps on my Mac, as well as on my iPhone. The first feature that it has is basically clipboard history. History which is there for at least one year. So if I want to copy-paste anything else, I can do it in just a few seconds. Apart from that, there is a button called as command Shift I. So if I want to improve my grammar or my text, I can do it. I have replaced my whisper flow with this app. Now, the last and my favorite feature is basically AI. If I want to use any other AI model, the pre-thing is under one umbrella. The name of the app is Raycast. To be honest, it's one of my favorite app that I use it every day. If you want to try it out, it's a free app, as well as there is a paid version of it. Try it out and let me know what do you think.
